info.title: PIM_Nexthop
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Nexthop](#/PIM_Nexthop)
The outgoing list of [PIM_Nexthop](#/PIM_Nexthop)s associated with this route entry. A route is a bridge entry if nexthops are empty or if it points to nexthops that are all in pruned state.

by_proxy_dr.description: When VSX PIM active-active feature is enabled, one of the VSX peer acts as DR and the other as proxy-DR. The multicast routes written in proxy-DR would have this flag set. If set, bridge entries are populated in the forwarding path instead of route entries.

is_pruned.description: If the value is `true`, then the nexthop entry is in pruned state.

l3_vni.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Downstream L3 Virtual Network Identifier on which the source stream is forwarded or pruned.

ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The downstream [Port](#/Port) on which the source stream is forwarded or pruned.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: PIM_Mroute.source_address
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Mroute](#/PIM_Mroute)
The Source Address of the stream.

parameters.name: PIM_Mroute.group_address
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Mroute](#/PIM_Mroute)
The Group Address of the stream.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
